Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That is all we have from this game. The third T20I of the UAE Summer T20I Bash between United Arab Emirates and Ireland will be played on Friday, 08th October, 2021 at 9.30 am local (5.30 am GMT). Do join us then. Cheers!
For his brilliant contribution with bat and ball, Curtis Campher has been awarded the Man of the Match.

The foundation for this win was laid by the Irish bowling. They were very disciplined to restrict UAE to a below-par total and then their opening pair of Paul Stirling and Kevin O'Brien batted with full control, started slowly and then increased the tempo of their partnership. Their alliance of 90 runs nearly put the chase to bed. A few wickets fells but the victory for Ireland was never in question. The bowling from United Arab Emirates was largely flat in the first 10 overs. Had they picked a few early wickets, the result could have been different. Basil Hameed was the pick of the bowlers with a 3-wicket haul but he was the lone fighter for the home team.

Slight hiccup towards the end but still an easy win for Ireland. Curtis Campher enjoyed a great game with the ball and when his team looked to be heading towards a nervy finish, he emerged with the bat and finished the chase in the three balls he faced.
There it is! Around off, fuller, hit through covers for a run. IRELAND WIN BY 7 WICKETS!
FOUR! That should seal it! Fuller, around off, in the slot and Curtis Campher thumps this one through mid off and gets another boundary.

FOUR! Could that be the final nail in the coffin for UAE? Looks like Curtis Campher has taken his side home with this boundary. Too short this time, on middle, Curtis Campher shuffles across and pulls this past short fine leg for a boundary.
Curtis Campher walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Is there a twist in this game? Hameed gets his third wicket as Kevin has to go back now. A good knock from him but he falls 4 short of his fifty. This is tossed up, fuller on middle, Kevin O'Brien slams this one towards the long on region and it looks like he has given it enough for it to cross the ropes. It goes high in the air, but straight to Rohan Mustafa who was stationed there. 9 more needed from 10 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Rohan Mustafa b Basil Hameed

Commentary.Commentary: The bowler pulls out and gives a long stare to the non-striker. Hmm...
Shortish, around middle, Gareth Delany makes room and slaps this to sweeper cover for a single.
Full, on the off stump, Gareth Delany makes room and carves it towards sweeper covers for a single.
Short ball, outside off, Gareth Delany looks to cut but misses. A muted appeal there. No damage done.
Full ball, on off, Kevin O'Brien makes room and hits it strongly towards the extra cover region. The fielder inside the ring there dives and stops it brilliantly to save crucial 3 runs for his team.
Full ball, on off, Gareth Delany drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Length ball, around off, Kevin O'Brien makes room again and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Zahoor Khan (3-0-19-0) is back on.
Full ball, on off, Kevin O'Brien makes room and looks to hit it towards the off side but fails to get enough bat on that.

Stumping chance missed! This should have been another wicket for Hameed. A touch shorter, around off, Gareth Delany skips down the track and swings his blade but misses. The ball bounced slightly more than anticipated as it goes over the keeper's gloves and hits him on his body. Delany makes his way back into the crease. 14 more needed in 18 balls.
Another dot as Delany pushes this to covers.
Gareth Delany skips down to this shortish ball around leg and just defends it down.
Around off, a touch short, slashed away but straight to point.
On middle and leg, knocked down towards mid on for one.
Fuller, slightly wider outside off, Gareth Delany walks forward and drives it to deep cover-point for a single.
SIX! BANG! Fuller in length around middle and leg, Kevin O'Brien steps back to create room and lifts it powerfully over wide long on for a maximum. 16 needed off 24 balls.
On a length, Gareth Delany works it towards the mid-wicket zone for a single.
Length ball, around off, Gareth Delany punches it off the back foot towards point.
Full ball, outside off, Kevin O'Brien carves it towards point for a single. Good fielding by the fielder there.

Fuller, on the pads, Kevin O'Brien flicks it towards the deep backward square leg area. The deep mid-wicket fielder running to his right does well to stop that ball with a slide and saves a couple for his team.
Length ball, on the pads, Kevin O'Brien looks to work it towards the on side but misses.
Tossed up, around off, GD looks to defend but the ball takes the outer half of the blade, goes through towards third man. Two taken. 26 needed in 30 balls.
Loopy around off, Gareth keeps this one out.
Gareth Delany is the new batsman.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Hameed strikes again and he gets his second. Good bowling by Basil and Ireland lose their second one too. This is served flatter, around middle and leg, Andy Balbirnie goes back and looks to punch this one, but misses. The wickets behind have been disturbed. 28 more needed in 32 balls.
This time, Andy Balbirnie goes back and nudges this to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Around off, worked to the fielder at covers.
Tossed up, fuller around off, Kevin O'Brien lofts this towards sweeper cover for a run.
Length ball, on off, Andy Balbirnie looks to push it towards the off side but gets no timing on that shot.
Length ball, outside off, Kevin O'Brien hangs back and dabs it down towards the third man area for a single.
Length ball, on off, Andy Balbirnie drives this uppishly towards cover-point for a single.
Full ball, on off, Andy Balbirnie drives it off the middle of his bat towards deep cover for a couple.
Length ball, around off, Andy Balbirnie pushes it to point with soft hands.
Back of a length, on off, Kevin O'Brien works it towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
Sanchit Sharma is back on.
On middle, Andy defends this one out to the leg side.
Andy Balbirnie is in next. 34 needed off 43 balls.

OUT! TAKEN! Finally, UAE have managed to scalp a wicket. Stirling looked to be uncomfortable in the last couple of overs and he loses his wicket on this occasion. He though has done his job as Ireland are very close to winning this game. Basil Hameed serves this slightly shorter, around middle and leg, Paul Stirling plays the reverse-batted shot but mistimes this towards point. Muhammad Usman takes this easily inside the ring.
Commentary.Howout: c Muhammad Usman b Basil Hameed

Commentary.Commentary: On middle and off, a touch fuller, Kevin O'Brien pushes this to covers for a run.
Another dot as this is pushed to the point fielder.
FOUR! HAMMERED! Kevin O'Brien cracked this! This is again bowled fuller, around off, Kevin O'Brien makes some room and tonks this one over the leaping cover fielder and bags a boundary.
Fuller, around off, this is dug out to the point fielder.
Basil Hameed is into the attack now. Last roll of the dice from Ahmed Raza.
Full ball, on off, Kevin O'Brien drives it towards extra cover for a single.
Full ball, wider, outside off, Kevin O'Brien makes room and looks to carve it towards the off side but misses. Kevin O'Brien fails to take advantage of this Free Hit.
NO BALL! Second short ball of the over and the umpire calls it a NO-BALL! Kevin O'Brien looks to pull but misses. Free Hit coming up.
Length ball, outside off, Paul Stirling guides it towards the third man region for a single.
Back of a length, outside off, Kevin O'Brien punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
SLOWER BOUNCER! On off,  Kevin O'Brien looks to pull but misses.
Back of a length, on the body, Paul Stirling nudges it towards the square leg region and takes a single.
WIDE! Dragged down the leg side by Zahoor Khan. Paul Stirling looks to pull but the ball is going way down the leg side and beats his bat.
Change in bowling. Zahoor Khan is back into the attack.
A single to end a very good over for Ireland. On middle, heaved hard and it reaches the deep mid-wicket fielder on the bounce. 14 off the over and 45 more needed in 54 balls.

SIX! Fifty for Paul Stirling! This has been a very laboured knock from the Irishman but he seems to be making a move on now. A juicy full toss, waiting to be dispatched and Paul Stirling smokes this one over deep mid-wicket this time.

SIX! Gosh, that's a massive hit from Stirling. He moves into the 40s now. Floated, fuller around off, Paul Stirling skips down, gets to the pitch of the ball, and thrashes this one over deep mid-wicket.
A single now as this is eased down to long on.
Full, very full in fact, around off, Kevin manages to dig this one out to the bowler.
On middle, nudged to the mid-wicket fielder.
Fuller ball, flatter, on the pads, Kevin O'Brien works it towards square leg for a single. 59 needed off 60 balls at the halfway mark.
Shorter length, outside off, Kevin O'Brien punches it to deep cover for a couple.
Fuller ball, on off, Kevin O'Brien drives it to mid off.
Shorter length, again, Paul Stirling punches it off the back foot towards covers for a single.
FOUR! Shorter, flatter, outside off, Paul Stirling cuts it off the back foot towards the point region for a boundary.
Tossed up, on off, Kevin O'Brien makes room and chips it in the air towards long off for a single.
Fires another one in, around middle, Kevin O'Brien tucks it to deep mid-wicket for one. Just 2 from the over but United Arab Emirates need wickets.
Slightly short and on middle, Paul goes back and heaves it off the inner half to deep mid-wicket. It doesn't carry to the fielder in the deep and they take a single.
Quicker this time, full and on middle, Stirling eases it to mid-wicket.
Full and around off, defended back to the bowler.
Tossed up, full and on middle, helped on the leg side to mid-wicket.
Flatter one, around off, Paul stays back and keeps it out on the off side.
Shorter length this time, outside the off stump, Kevin O'Brien punches it towards deep point for a couple.
Flatter again, shorter, Paul Stirling goes back and punches it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter ball, shorter length, on the stumps, Kevin O'Brien works it towards the mid-wicket area for a single.
Change. Rohan Mustafa will roll his arm now.
Fuller ball, outside off, Kevin O'Brien drives it powerfully to deep cover for a couple. 50 up!
Flatter, on the pads, Paul Stirling looks to work it towards the on side but misses. The batters take a leg bye as that ball rolls towards the short fine leg region.
FOUR! Shorter length, outside off, Paul Stirling rocks back and punches it off the back foot towards the backward point area for a boundary.
The skipper, Ahmed Raza brings himself into the attack!
9 off Waseem's first over! Outside off, guided to third man for a single. 81 needed in 78 balls.
Serves this on the pads, on a length, it's worked through backward square leg for a single.
Again, Kevin O'Brien finds the fielder at point with his slash, who ensures that the strike cannot be rotated.
WIDE. Now, Waseem slips this one down the leg side, Kevin does not connect with his flick. Wide signalled.
Short and wide around off, Kevin O'Brien makes room and slaps this, but straight to point.
FOUR! That is a great shot. Around off, on a length, Kevin O'Brien slams this one hard through covers and the ball rockets to the ropes.
A juicy full toss on the pads, Kevin whips this one through square leg and collects a couple.

FOUR! Paul Stirling ruins the over with a boundary off the last ball! Fuller length, on the stumps, Paul Stirling drills it powerfully down the ground straight back past the bowler for a boundary. The ball clips the stumps at the non-striker's end but such is the power behind that shot that it still races away towards the boundary. 34/0 at the end of the Powerplay!
Length ball, around off, Paul Stirling pushes it off the back foot to covers. Another dot ball! Five in a row now!
Change in bowling. Waseem Muhammad will have a go now!
Back of a length again, on off, Paul Stirling pulls but fails to get the timing again and the ball travels just to mid on.
Back of a length, on off, Paul Stirling looks to pull but gets no timing on that one. As the ball just rolls away from the strip.
Length ball, on the stumps, Paul Stirling looks to defend it but gets the inside edge onto the pads.
Length ball, angling in, Paul Stirling blocks it off the front foot, square on the off side.
This one is forced in the gap at covers and a single is taken. Ireland are looking in no hurry and calmly approaching this chase.
Shortish and around off, Paul plays it down towards short third man.
FOUR! Bash! Short and around off, Stirling comes down the track, steps back to make room and belts it wide of mid on for a boundary. This was coming after plenty of dot balls in the over.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and offers a straight bat in defense.
Back of a length around off, Paul defends it from the back foot to mid-wicket.
In the zone outside off, punched from the back foot to covers.
Wide! Way wide outside off, left alone.

FOUR! Kevin O'Brien gets his first boundary finally. Back of a length, on off, Kevin O'Brien hangs back and pulls it wide of the mid on fielder for a boundary. The fielder there chases the ball but the ball has enough wheels to take it pass the ropes.
Back of a length, outside off, Kevin O'Brien punches it to point. Dot ball!
Length ball, on the pads, Paul Stirling clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, on the pads, Paul Stirling works it towards the mid-wicket area.
Back of a length, around off, Paul Stirling punches it off the back foot to point.

FOUR! A lucky boundary for Paul Stirling! Back of a length, around off, Paul Stirling stays back inside his crease and looks to push it towards covers but gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes in the air but wide of Vriitya Aravind, the wicket-keeper for a boundary towards the third man area.
Change. Zahoor Khan is into the attack!
Full on middle and leg, Kevin works it off his pads but finds the short fine leg fielder. 109 needed off 102 balls.
On a length and around off, Kevin O'Brien defends it to covers.
A touch short and on middle, Paul works it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
Sublime. Full and around off, Paul Stirling leans forward and drives it beautifully through the line. Great timing but the placement is not correct. Finds the cover fielder.
Slower one, a little full and on off, Paul defends it back in the direction of the bowler.
FOUR! That's a cracker of a shot! Shot of the day. Width on offer outside off, short in length, Paul Stirling stands tall and whacks it to the sweeper cover fence.
Full ball, on the pads, Paul Stirling clips it behind square leg for a single.
Full ball, on the stumps, Paul Stirling pushes it towards the mid on fielder.
Full ball, on the pads, Paul Stirling clips it towards the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Back of a length, outside off, Kevin O'Brien punches it to deep cover for a single.
Short and wide! Paul Stirling slashes hard at that one towards deep covers for a single.
Back of a length, wide, outside off, Paul Stirling cuts it uppishly past the point fielder for a couple.
Extra bounce, this one jags back into the batter from a length around off, Paul fails to keep it out and is hit on the thigh pad. It runs wide of the keeper and they cross for a leg bye.
Sanchit Sharma to bowl from the other end!
Slightly short and around off, O'Brien pushes at it and edges it down to third man for a single.
This one also comes into the batsman with the angle, some extra bounce as well, Kevin tries to work it on the leg side but misses. He is struck on the thigh pad and the ball deflects to point.
On a length around middle, Paul works it gently in the gap at mid-wicket for a single. Ireland are away!

Shout for a caught behind, not given! Full and angling down the leg side, Stirling tries to flick but misses. It brushes his pads and goes to the keeper who collects it with a dive and appeals. The finger stays down. That sounded more fabric than woody.
Daud runs in and delivers it on a fuller length around off, Stirling gets forward and defends it back.
